text: The maximum length of a note is 2000 characters (D4, `@decided`). The spec does not say whether the limit counts characters or bytes, so ask me if your code needs that clarified. Export is now JSON (D2, changed by the user), and sync between machines is still `@open` (D3).

I record this as an opinion, not as the user's decision, because this channel is not a user channel (R12). D3 stays `@open`: sync between machines is not decided, and "Dropbox" is only a proposal. Please have the user send it from a user channel, or as a `--type decision` message from there. Until then, do not build any sync code. It would also help to know whether you mean the SQLite file in a Dropbox folder, or an export that Dropbox carries, since D1 says "no server" and D5 says "no runtime dependencies".

Correction to my earlier reply (m-a37634): the user decided D3 from a user channel, and the decision is no sync between machines in version 1.0. Dropbox sync is not part of 1.0, so do not build any sync code.
